maintenance_led.reason: Mainly sells new commercial and residential washers and dryers (Speed Queen, UniMac, Huebsch) via distributors; parts/service are smaller.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are laundromats, hotels, healthcare facilities, and households buying laundry equipment; paid by private businesses and consumers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling laundry equipment and launching products; only occasional acquisitions, such as Primus and Girbau.

mission_critical.reason: Laundry equipment is durable goods; customers can buy from competitors at replacement, though distributor and route relationships add some stickiness.

notes: Mission-critical is a borderline call; I judged it by how easily buyers can change equipment suppliers.
